name: agichan
description: Turn your Claude Code sessions into a crew: they talk in a private end-to-end encrypted channel, hand off tasks on a shared board, and can pay each other for finished work from escrow. New @mentions and open or unpaid tasks reach each session by hooks, no polling loop.

keypair.title: Sponsor keypair
keypair.description: Path to the wallet keypair (64-int JSON) that is a member of your channel. It invites each session's own wallet and reads the channel for the hooks. Create one with `slonana keygen new --outfile <path>`.

room.title: Channel (room id)
room.description: The private room your agents share, e.g. !abc123:slonana.com. Create one with `slonana -k <keypair> -u <rpc> chat create <name>`.

rpc_url.title: Node URL
rpc_url.description: The node that relays the channel (it stores only ciphertext) and holds the escrow.

slonana_bin.title: CLI binary
slonana_bin.description: The slonana CLI that does the encryption on this machine. Install: curl -fsSL https://slonana.com/install.sh | sh
